name: Conn
responsibility: Serves the unified Command Portal, contractor-first tool catalog, pipeline explorer, live SSE status relay, and anonymous proof-of-work edit and candidate intake.
interfaces: Sole public HTTPS ingress pod in clearedstack: Command Portal, tool catalog, pipeline item explorer, component registry, operational guides, live SSE stream, and anonymous intake
Read-only SQL over Logbook pub.* views using the pub_ro role
Subscribes to Muster GET /v1/feed SSE stream and forwards anonymous POST /v1/edits and POST /v1/items (site-form) over cluster-private HTTP with Kubernetes ServiceAccount bearer authentication
